findings.evidence: Mathlib/RingTheory/DiscreteValuationRing/Basic.lean:707 defines `Irreducible.maximalIdeal_pow_eq_setOfPred_le_v_coe_pow`; lines 114–116 only apply `Set.ext_iff.mp` to it.
findings.fix: Delete the helper and rewrite its call sites directly with `hπ.maximalIdeal_pow_eq_setOfPred_le_v_coe_pow`.
findings.issue: `mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff` merely converts the existing set equality into pointwise membership.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/GroupTheory/ArchimedeanDensely.lean:34 defines `exists_pow_lt₀ {a} (ha : a < 1) (b : Gˣ) : ∃ n, a ^ n < b`; Mathlib/RingTheory/Valuation/ValuativeRel/Basic.lean:1312 supplies `MulArchimedean (ValueGroupWithZero K)`.
findings.fix: Replace it with `exists_pow_lt₀ (Valuation.integer.v_irreducible_lt_one hπ) (Units.mk0 γ hγ)` and simplify the resulting coercion.
findings.issue: `exists_pow_valuation_lt` rederives Mathlib's general power-cofinality theorem in 17 lines.

summary: Two private helpers duplicate existing Mathlib results instead of reusing them directly.
